confirmation.advisor.title: Application sent successfully!
confirmation.advisor.subhead: The applicant can now review, sign, and submit their application.
confirmation.edit.title: Edit request sent!
confirmation.edit.subhead: Your advisor has been notified of your request to edit your application.
confirmation.advisor.message: The application has been sent to the following applicant for review. You will be notified when the application is signed or if any edits are needed.
confirmation.edit.announcement: Your request has been sent to your advisor.
